description:
## Goal

Dogfood the toolkit from `execute/tool-authoring-go-toolkit` by converting the existing hand-written tool implementations in `agent-manager` and `scenario-to-cloud` to use it. This is the proof that the toolkit actually reduces boilerplate and fits real usage; without this step, the toolkit is unvalidated.

## Expected Work

- Convert `scenarios/agent-manager/api/internal/toolregistry/*` tools to the new toolkit.
- Convert `scenarios/scenario-to-cloud/api/toolregistry/*` tools to the new toolkit.
- Relocate to canonical `api/tools/` per the research decision.
- Keep `/api/v1/tools` output byte-equivalent (or document the diff).

## Acceptance

- Both scenarios expose identical tool manifests via `/api/v1/tools` to what they did before migration.
- Line count for tool definitions is reduced significantly per the research target.
- All existing tests still pass.
name: tool-authoring-migrate-existing
title: Migrate agent-manager and scenario-to-cloud tools to the new toolkit
